name: Netherward Path
descriptionTemplate: Lose 10% Current HP, deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG to all enemies and inflict 1 turn of {Vulnerable}.
lore:
In the dark, Doresain opened his eyes again.
No sentiment. No hatred. Only the exquisite pleasure of a borrowed body, of teeth meeting meat.
He had always known where this path would lead.
